## Experience

:::: {.cv-item}
::: {.cv-item__head}
[HPC & Cloud Specialist]{.cv-item__role}[Oct 2022 – present]{.cv-item__dates}
:::
::: {.cv-item__org}
[Leibniz Supercomputing Centre (LRZ)]{.cv-item__place}[Garching bei München, DE]{.cv-item__loc}
:::

- Administered and maintained 5+ clusters of Rocky and Ubuntu virtual machines on the LRZ OpenStack Compute Cloud, provisioning scalable environments for teaching and research.
- Automated infrastructure deployment and configuration management with Ansible, Terraform and Magic Castle.
- Managed Kubernetes clusters (RKE/RKE2 with Docker/containerd as container runtime) via Rancher Fleet for CI/CD.
- Set up Apache2, ufw and a Caddy reverse proxy, with automated SSL certificates via ACME and Certbot.
- Configured custom Jupyter IDE containers integrated with XFS and NFS for persistent user storage.
- Maintained 2 Slurm clusters, overseeing software-stack provisioning via Spack, EESSI and Conda environments.
- Applied Julia's KernelAbstractions.jl for backend-agnostic GPU offloading in GaPSE.jl.
- Worked with High-Performance Computing paradigms (OpenMP, MPI) and hardware architectures (e.g. ccNUMA domains).
- Troubleshot network configurations with netcat, Wireshark and tcptraceroute.
- Main LRZ instructor for the course *Introduction to Julia* (Jun 2026).
- Supported dozens of training courses hosted on these clusters, with 10 to 70 participants each.
::::
